evidence_excerpts: Fundamental to this endeavor are quantum interconnects that convert quantum states from one physical system to those of another in a reversible fashion.
Desiderata for a quantum interface include user-controlled coupling, robustness against imperfections, efficient error detection, and the rate hierarchy χ >> κ >> γ.
text: Large quantum networks require reversible interconnects that convert quantum states between matter and light while preserving coherence and entanglement.
